summary_md:
# Analytikern: Storbolagen med störst uppsida

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-08-24  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Analyst Martin Björsell and host Agneta argue that the Q2 reporting season broadened earnings growth across more sectors. They expect H2 to be driven more by valuation, favouring companies that are not expensively valued. Picks: Ericsson, on a price drop they see as an overreaction to its gross-margin guidance; SEB and Nordea, on the bank earnings momentum and recovering corporate lending; Essity, as a transformation/spin-off case helped by Cevian coming in; and SKF, as a self-help margin story ahead of its separation.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 ERIC-B — Ericsson | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Market overreacted to gross-margin guidance; ~15x P/E, below its historical valuation, good dividend yield, strong balance sheet.

#### Reasoning

Analyst (Martin) says Ericsson has historically offset tariffs and component-price pressure, so the Q3 gross-margin pressure should be temporary. The stock trades at a discount to its history (~15x earnings) with a strong balance sheet and a good dividend yield. The new CEO inherits a restructured company; continued share gains in Europe are key.

#### Sell Triggers

- if gross-margin pressure proves long-lasting beyond Q3
- if Ericsson stops gaining market share in Europe
- if the new CEO changes strategy

> *"Jag tycker den platsar väldigt väl in i en portfölj idag."*

---

### 🟢 SEB-A — SEB | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Stronger-than-expected Q2; return on capital not reflected in valuation; leveraged to corporate lending and cyclical recovery.

#### Reasoning

Analyst's favourite bank: Q2 beat expectations, and return on capital justifies a higher valuation. The worst for banks is behind them, earnings momentum is positive and corporate lending shows green shoots. It is a play on continued cyclical recovery. The host also has SEB as a favourite.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the cyclical recovery stalls
- if corporate lending growth reverses
- if interest rates fall sharply

> *"Då tror jag att SEB är ett bra spel på det."*

---

### 🟢 NDA-SE — Nordea | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host's stock of the week earlier in the year, has beaten the market; strong corporate growth, looks cheap, AI efficiency gains.

#### Reasoning

Host (Agneta) is sticking with Nordea after it outperformed the index. She points to strong growth on the corporate side and in bond issuance, and expects this to continue for the rest of the year. AI-driven cost efficiency adds support. The analyst notes that Nordea delivers strongly and looks cheap, although his firm does not cover it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if corporate growth slows
- if market share is won mainly through pricing
- if costs rise faster than income

> *"Jag kör på Nordea också. Den satte vi som veckans aktie i början av året och har hittills gått bättre än börsen som helhet."*

---

### 🟢 ESSITY-B — Essity | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Transformation towards high-margin products; possible Consumer Tissue separation; Cevian's entry; substantial valuation upside if CT is removed.

#### Reasoning

Analyst recommends it: separating the volatile Consumer Tissue business would unlock valuation upside for the rest of the company. Acquisitions are in line with the stated strategy, and the business is delivering organically even without Cevian. The host agrees but warns the process takes longer than expected; the stock has been dull, but it suits a quieter market climate.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the spin-off/separation is shelved
- if margin improvement fails to materialise
- if Cevian exits

> *"Kan man få bort det, då tror jag att då finns det en rejäl värderingsuppsida på den övriga delen."*

---

### 🟢 SKF-B — SKF | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Low valuation relative to a strong engineering sector; self-help margin story; separation ready; benefits from European recovery.

#### Reasoning

Analyst positive: much of the engineering sector is already highly valued, while SKF is not. Margin expansion from internal efforts should come even in a tough automotive market and economy. The separation of its businesses is ready, which can deliver fast margin gains. It also gets a lift if the European economy recovers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if margin expansion fails
- if the separation is delayed
- if demand in the automotive industry falls sharply

> *"SKF är du positiv till i verkstadssektorn? Ja, det är jag."*

---
